tests.name: 15 000 words, 15 000 searches
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(211)
letters = 'abcdefghij'
words = [''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(4, 10))) for _ in range(15000)]
ops = [('add', w) for w in words]
for _ in range(15000):
    w = list(random.choice(words) if random.random() < 0.5 else ''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(4, 10))))
    for _ in range(random.choice([0, 1, 1, 2])):
        w[random.randrange(len(w))] = '.'
    ops.append(('search', ''.join(w)))
tests.expected: (8756, [False, True, True, True, True, True, False, True, True, False, True, True, False, False, True, False, True, False, False, False, True, True, False, True, True, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, False, True, False, True, True, True, True])
